programmes.d: A cheating husband sees his secret revealed and its horrible consequences on his just-repaired TV set.
An astronaut arrives back on Earth, then notices things have changed in his absence.
Barbara accidentally causes her cruel Uncle Simon's death. His will stipulates that she must care for his latest invention - a robot. The robot begins to take on Uncle Simon's traits.
A 12-year-old girl who lost her parents in a fire doesn't speak because she has grown up in a secret telepathic community.
Jeff Myrtlebank comes back to life at his own funeral and soon begins to act very strangely...
A timid vacuum-cleaner salesman is given the strength of 300 men by some experimenting aliens.
Jess-Belle enlists the aid of a local witch who casts a spell that makes Billy-Ben fall in love with her.
An alcoholic bookie regrets that he wasn't a better father to his son, Pip, critically wounded in South Vietnam. A visit to an amusement park gives them both a second chance.

Three astronauts have returned from this first space flight. Major Gart is hospitalized with a broken leg. The other two, Colonels Harrington and Forbes head for a bar. Harrington gets a strange feeling…
Three National Guardsmen explore the site of Custer's Last Stand and encounter mysterious phenomenon that hint at the original battle occurring just out of sight.
The Earth's orbit has been changed, drawing ever closer to the sun and promising imminent destruction.
David Gurney wakes up to find that no one - his wife, his co-workers, his best friend, not even his own mother knows him.
The Kanamits, 9-foot tall aliens, arrive on Earth with one lofty goal: To Serve Man.
A pilot of a downed WW II bomber comes to in the African desert and desperately tries to find out what happened to the rest of his crew.
A playwright makes characters come to life.

Major Ivan Kuchenko is trapped inside a hotel room with Commissar Vassiloff, a hitman, and Boris, his assistant, in the room across the street. Vassiloff has planted a bomb in the room and Ivan must find it within three hours or be blown to bits.
Trying to keep up with his younger wife, Harmon convinces his brother to inject him with an experimental youth serum.
A young woman lying in a hospital bed, her head wrapped in bandages, awaits the outcome of a surgical procedure performed by the State in a last-ditch attempt to make her look 'normal'.
In a future totalitarian society, a librarian is declared obsolete and sentenced to death.
An elderly couple visit the New Life Corporation, hoping to transport their personalities into youthful artificial bodies.
A trumpet player who's convinced he'll never amount to anything attempts suicide and finds himself in a world where no one can hear or see him.
A hypochondriac exchanges his soul for immortality and indestructibility.
A ventriloquist is convinced that his dummy, Willie, is alive and evil. He makes plans for a new act with a new dummy: plans that Willie doesn't support!
An alien who crash-lands into a remote mountain village stirs up the villagers' fears and animosity, but he befriends a little boy and gives him a mysterious present.
A man travels back in time to try to prevent some of history's catastrophes.
When a newlywed couple briefly returns to the groom's childhood home, the ties of the past prove too strong to resist.
